text:
leo: Quick heads-up 1 Im planning to be in Raleigh, NC for ~45 days (2026-06-10 -> 2026-07-24) for a family thing + coworking. Two quick asks: 1) How do we handle the monthly WFH stipend when I'm only there part of the month? 2) Will NC withholding kick in for a short stay? 3) Do I need to touch benefits/homebase? 4) Can IT ship a power adapter to my Raleigh address?
maria (people-ops): Thanks for the notice! TL;DR: stipend pro-rated by days worked remote in the month, payroll will compute; short stays normally don't create company tax nexus but you may have withholding; don't change homebase for temporary trips; submit the Temp Remote form and include shipping checkbox for IT.
leo: where's the form? also curious if benefits (medical) will be affected if insurer asks for local address during claims?
elaine (benefits): insurer notifications: short trips usually don't require updating your address for coverage, but if you register a local PCP or file claims in-state, they may request your primary address. If you're keeping primary residence the same, you should be fine. If you expect medical services in Raleigh, DM me and i'll note it on the case.
payroll-bot: Ticket PR-4999 created to estimate stipend proration and any withholding delta. Please allow 48 business hours for a calc.
samir (legal): Legal note: North Carolina taxes nonresident wages earned in-state. For a ~45 day stint, withholding may apply for days worked in NC; this is wage-level withholding, not necessarily company-level nexus. Finance will confirm whether we need to remit state withholding for that period.
leo: OK submitting form now. Shipping details:
```
Leo Tan
c/o Neighbor - 210 Oak St Apt 4
Raleigh, NC 27601
dates: 2026-06-10 - 2026-07-24
contact: +1-919-555-0102
```

alex (it): We can ship adapter only. If you need full device transfer, we need manager approval and signed equipment waiver. For adapter, just include shipping checkbox on temp form and i'll route it. Ship ETA 2-4 business days after request.
maria (people-ops): Please also indicate if you'll be doing any customer meetings while in NC (customer-facing travel can change tax/expense rules). If no, we're good. Once payroll gives numbers, i'll post back here.
leo: No customer meetings. Form submitted and adapter requested. Thanks all.
payroll-bot: PR-4999 update: Estimated stipend proration for June = $75.00 (pro-rated), estimated NC withholding for July payroll = small delta (~$18), payroll will adjust on next cycle. Ticket closing in 72 hours if no follow up.
maria (people-ops): Noted. Ellaine/Legal/Payroll: thanks for the quick checks. Leo: enjoy Raleigh and ping if you need local medical help or transit recs :wave:
